verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for an email API SaaS like Resend, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage or sending region, or any residency control. The community comment about 'where I want to be' concerns dashboard UI navigation, not data location, so it is irrelevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
